sumInsured: Not specified in extract (policy schedule will show chosen Sum Insured; illustrations show examples like ₹5,00,000)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred towards stay during Hospitalization
great.explanation: There is no cap on room rent charges during hospitalization, so you can choose any room without worrying about extra costs. This avoids proportionate deductions related to room upgrades.

great.name: ICU Charges
great.quote: Intensive Care Unit Charges (ICU Charges): The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit'
great.explanation: ICU charges have no separate limit, reducing your out-of-pocket expenses during critical care stays. This ensures full coverage of ICU costs up to the sum insured.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: The policy allows unlimited reinstatements of the base sum insured within the policy year, including for the same illness. This provides extra coverage if your base sum insured is exhausted.

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote: In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.
great.explanation: Your no claim bonus continues to accumulate even after making a claim, so your sum insured can grow over time without resetting. This is a best-in-class feature.

great.name: Sum Insured Bonus
great.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis, as a Cumulative Bonus for each completed and continuous Policy Year
great.explanation: The sum insured increases by 50% each policy year you stay claim-free, up to 100% extra. This gives you an additional buffer beyond the base sum insured.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Advance Technology Methods: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to the Sum Insured... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Stereotactic radio surgeries ... Bronchical Thermoplasty ...
great.explanation: Several advanced medical treatments are covered up to the sum insured without separate sub-limits. This ensures access to modern procedures under your policy.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the start of coverage. This is a standard waiting period in retail health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses are excluded for 24 months from policy start, which is a typical waiting period for specific conditions.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except for accidents, which is a common initial waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization
good.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered, helping with costs leading up to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization
good.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital
good.explanation: Expenses for up to 180 days after hospital discharge are covered, assisting with recovery costs.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person... for the Medical Expenses incurred towards Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Home-based treatment is covered when medically necessary, subject to conditions and exclusions. This provides flexibility if hospital admission is not possible.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables like gloves and masks are excluded by default, which can lead to out-of-pocket expenses unless you buy an optional cover.

bad.name: Restore Benefit Trigger
bad.quote: The Recharge shall be utilized only after the base Sum Insured, applicable Cumulative Bonus , Cumulative Bonus Super (if applicable) and Plus Benefit (if applicable) have been completely exhausted in that Policy Year.
bad.explanation: The restore benefit activates only after you exhaust your base sum insured and all bonuses, so it is a last-resort feature rather than early support.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion ( If opted ) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim...
bad.reference: General Conditions Applicable To All The Benefits And Optional Benefits, point 4; and Optional Benefit 3.2.7
bad.explanation: Co-payment is described as optional and not clearly stated for the base plan, so it is unclear if any co-pay applies by default without checking the policy schedule.
